messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: R 3.4.0
parts: For those who have updated to R 3.4.0 and are using a ctmm version from CRAN (or any version <=0.3.6), you have probably noticed the many new warnings introduced by R 3.4.0 regarding depreciated matrix/array operations. ctmm beta 0.4.0 packaged on my website or installable from GitHub (both listed above in the welcome message) should have all of these warnings fixed. If you see any such remaining warnings, then please submit an issue on GitHub or report them here.
